digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, file-impact scoping, attestation validity
propositions: Empty file_impact is overloaded: it conflates 'author forgot to declare' with 'genuinely no file impact', forcing conservative whole-HEAD invalidation for both cases
Undeclared file_impact causes dependency_hashes to return empty dict, triggering whole-HEAD freshness check on any commit
A non-closed child with empty file_impact poisons the parent container's inherited drift scope, collapsing careful sibling declarations to whole-HEAD invalidation
The tri-state file_impact_scope (undeclared, paths, none) must be part of the material fingerprint so state transitions invalidate attestations and force re-review

An explicit 'none' declaration with required no_file_impact_reason must bypass whole-HEAD invalidation, container poison, and P9 advisory, while a new plan-review criterion judges the claim's truthfulness
